propositions: The single-pass demo review-a-ticket engine and related scaffolding (parity harness, prompt, eval spec, eval-solver branch) must be fully retired with catalog containing exactly one default reviewer and four-phase workflows byte-unchanged.
Finished-cutover artifacts including shadow comparators, spot-eval harness, and private re-exports must be deleted and their importers migrated.
Severity must be removed from gate policy drivers, REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH removed with prefetch always enabled, and legacy overlay activate: list form deprecated with single warning per overlay.
Five confirmed-dead attestation helpers must be removed, duplicated unresolvable-ref message single-sourced, and plan-review status surface aligned to schema declarations.
All client-facing changes require release-notes entries.
